taglines: It is Thursday which is close enough to Friday that you can feel it but not close enough to do anything about it and that gap between almost-there and there is the gap where most of your ambition currently lives and it is a fine place for ambition as long as you don't look directly at it.

You are one good night of sleep away from feeling like a completely different person and you know this and you are choosing to do something else instead and you have opinions about other people's choices and you are holding both of these facts simultaneously without letting them touch.

June 25th which means the year is basically half over except it passed that point a week ago and you were busy so you are processing it now and the processing feels exactly like the original thing would have felt except slower and with more ambient regret which is how you prefer to handle most milestones.

Your phone battery is at 23% and you are not going to charge it yet because charging it now would require finding the cable and you know where the cable is but you are in a flow state of doing nothing in particular and you are not going to break that for 23%.

There are people right now who are doing the thing you said you were going to do and they are doing it without waiting to feel ready and they are going to finish it and you are going to hear about it and feel a very complicated thing and then say you're proud of them which will also be true at the same time.

The afternoon slump is not a failure of willpower it is your body staging a completely reasonable protest against the architecture of the modern workday and you should honor that protest by getting some water and then sitting back down and doing the thing anyway because the protest has been noted and denied.

You have been meaning to respond to that message for four days now and the longer you wait the more the response needs to account for the waiting and soon you will need to address the gap itself and the gap keeps getting wider and you are just watching it widen with the tired acceptance of someone watching a tab load on slow wifi.

At some point today something will work on the first try and you will not know what to do with that extra two minutes you budgeted for troubleshooting and you will probably use them to think about all the other things that did not work on the first try and this is called balance and it is how you stay grounded.
